leadText:
Pokémon the First Movie is a graphic novel published by VIZ Media in North America and Shogakukan in Japan. It is a manga-style book (called "Animation Comics" by VIZ at the time of publication, now branded as "Ani-Manga") which retells the plot of Mewtwo Strikes Back and Pikachu's Vacation using screenshots from the film. Satoshi Tajiri and Tsunekazu Ishihara are credited as the authors.

In Japan, the comic was simply published as one bound volume. For the North American release, it was split up into five monthly issues, which were later rereleased in a bound volume. The first four issues tell the story of Mewtwo Strikes Back, while the fifth tells the story of Pikachu's Vacation.

The Pikachu's Vacation comic would later be republished in the All That Pikachu! Ani-Manga.

It is a manga-style book (called "Animation Comics" by VIZ at the time of publication, now branded as "Ani-Manga") which retells the plot of Mewtwo Strikes Back and Pikachu's Vacation using screenshots from the film. Satoshi Tajiri and Tsunekazu Ishihara are credited as the authors.

In Japan, the comic was simply published as one bound volume. For the North American release, it was split up into five monthly issues, which were later rereleased in a bound volume. The first four issues tell the story of Mewtwo Strikes Back, while the fifth tells the story of Pikachu's Vacation.

The Pikachu's Vacation comic would later be republished in the All That Pikachu! Ani-Manga.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Synopsis==
This book follows the plot of the film of the same name and the Pikachu short Pikachu's Vacation.

===Chapters===
Prologue (Japanese: プロローグ Prologue)
Chapter 1: To The Island of Storms (Japanese: 第１章： 嵐の島へ Chapter 1: To the Stormy Island)
Chapter 2: The Ultimate Trainer (Japanese: 第２章： 最強のトレーナー Chapter 2: The Strongest Trainer)
Chapter 3: The Ultimate Poké Ball (Japanese: 第３章： 黒いモンスターボール Chapter 3: The Black Poké Balls)
Chapter 4: Mew vs. Mewtwo (Japanese: 第４章： ミュウVSミュウツー Chapter 4: Mew vs. Mewtwo)
Pikachu's Vacation (Japanese: ピカチュウのなつやすみ Pikachu's Summer Vacation)

==Gallery==
 
File:Mewtwo Strikes Back monthly issue 1.png|VIZ Media issue #1 cover artwork
File:Pikachu Vacation monthly issue.png|VIZ Media issue #5 cover artwork
 

==Trivia==
Raymond is simply named "Pirate Trainer" in this book.

===Errors===
On one page in the fourth chapter, and 's lines are switched, and thus inconsistent with the movie's dialogue.
